title: H1.37 frozen-adapter fresh-task paired evaluation (no retraining)
objective: Test whether the already-trained H1.36 self-evolution SD-LoRA adapter improves reward on a previously untouched WebShop task sample relative to its frozen Qwen2.5-7B base, without any retraining or hyperparameter change.
scientific_question: Given the already-trained H1.36 self-evolution adapter (worker sd-lora-b7e36404ca6320620e3f86e5225699e3), does it improve reward on a previously untouched WebShop task sample relative to its frozen Qwen2.5-7B base?
explicitly_not_tested: This campaign does NOT re-ask 'can 7B open the capability gate' -- H1.36 already reinterpreted that question (both 3B and 7B crossed the >=2-task / >=8-episode data-qualification threshold). The open variable is transfer, not capability.
rationale: H1.36 produced an underpowered null on an 8-task x 4-seed frozen panel (mean paired delta ~ -0.0036/attempt, one positive task per arm). Its evaluation tasks were training-unseen but previously consumed in H1.29, and 8 tasks cannot distinguish 'no effect' from 'small effect in noise'. H1.37 freezes the exact H1.36 base + trained adapter and evaluates paired on 64 previously untouched tasks to get a statistically meaningful read on fresh-task transfer without touching LR/rank/epoch/data, so there is no 'rescue H1.36' researcher-degrees-of-freedom concern.
direction: A - strong-base pure self-evolution (frozen-artifact evaluation; no teacher)
split: no training; frozen-artifact paired evaluation on a previously untouched 64-task sample
independent_variable: evaluation task sample ONLY (64 previously untouched WebShop tasks). Every model/adapter/parser/inference variable is frozen identical to the H1.36 v3 evaluation.

frozen_objects.base_model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct local content pin 0c32faf81d8f2f83cf79860d2a48111f166348d6dd38cd348576d8b3a0141c1e (same checkpoint as H1.36)
frozen_objects.self_evolution_adapter: H1.36-trained SD-LoRA adapter worker sd-lora-b7e36404ca6320620e3f86e5225699e3 under run phase-h1.36-strong-base-self-evolution-v1-20260818; content sha256 pinned fail-closed at launch
frozen_objects.inference_contract: temperature 0.0, max_steps 30, max_new_tokens 512, environment_seed 2026, rollout seeds [2026090200, 2026090201, 2026090202, 2026090203]

forbidden_changes: no new self-generated records added to the dataset
no post-hoc manifest / task-sample swap after seeing results

primary_estimand.definition: Delta = (1/N) * sum_i (R_self,i - R_base,i), the mean paired reward difference per episode over all valid paired attempts
primary_estimand.note: H1.36 exposed that a cumulative paired-delta SUM is easily misread as a mean; H1.37 reports the mean per-episode delta as the headline and never the raw sum as the headline.

inference.unit: task (cluster): 64 task-level paired effects, not 512 independent episodes
methods_preregistered: task-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for the mean paired per-episode delta (resample tasks with replacement, keep all of a task's episodes)
task-level sign-flip paired randomization test (two-sided p-value)

interpretation_zones_preregistered.transfer-positive: task-cluster CI95 lower bound > 0 -- first credible evidence that a frozen self-generated SD-LoRA update transfers to unseen WebShop tasks
interpretation_zones_preregistered.clean-negative: Delta ~= 0 with a narrow CI (half-width <= 0.05) containing 0 -- Qwen2.5-7B can generate successful endogenous training data and the optimizer internalizes it, yet the update fails to improve task-level generalization; this directly motivates the H1.38 task-diversity campaign
interpretation_zones_preregistered.underpowered: CI still wide (half-width > 0.05) -- H1.37 remains underpowered; this is NOT a negative result

manifest_sealing.exclusion_policy: exclude every goal_idx selected/observed/consumed in any prior committed campaign (superset of H1.29/H1.36 train+eval and the H1.36 self-generated-training task identities)

next_hypothesis_if_clean_negative: H1.38: at a fixed record budget, vary ONLY the number of distinct self-generated-training task identities (e.g. 32 records / 4 tasks vs 32 / 16 vs 32 / 32) to test whether self-generated-data task diversity -- not capability -- determines transfer. This is more scientifically valuable than sweeping LoRA rank/LR/epoch.
claim_boundary: H1.37 can establish only whether the frozen H1.36 adapter yields a fresh-task distributional gain over its frozen base on an untouched sample. It cannot claim Q3, H2, SEED superiority, retention, or GPT/OPSD equivalence.
hard_boundaries: Run one UUID-bound child container per GPU; scientific processes use UID/GID 1001:1001.
Do not delete, restart or reset unrelated containers or GPUs.
No training in this campaign; evaluation traces never enter any dataset.
Invalid runtime/parser/identity attempts are retained but excluded from scientific denominators.
Do not claim a SEED win from H1.37; the SEED comparison needs a separate frozen matched contract.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after exact online initialization failure is saved in wandb-online-probe.json and the completed spool receives a hash
